component.name: Apache Portable Runtime (APR)
component.description: Portable runtime libraries. The security page explains how to report security problems in the APR source code (privately to security@apache.org before public disclosure) and states the project's stance on denial-of-service reports.

externalReferences.comment: Source security page; this file is a structured translation of it.

threats.name: Resource consumption in a non-linear relationship to input size
threats.description: The project's general philosophy is to prevent attacks which can cause the server to consume resources in a non-linear relationship to the size of inputs.

threats.name: Generic denial-of-service attacks against networked servers
threats.description: All networked servers are subject to denial of service attacks, and the project cannot promise magic workarounds to generic problems.
